I. It applies to all recognized private schools in Delhi.

questions.explanation_english: I and III only The Delhi School Education Act, 1973 applies to all recognized private schools in Delhi, whereas higher educational colleges affiliated with Delhi University fall outside its legal purview. Provisions regarding managing committee structure and disciplinary approval (Sections 8–11) Section 12 of the Delhi School Education Act, 1973 explicitly exempts unaided minority institutions from Chapter IV provisions, specifically Sections 8 through 11, which regulate managing committee compositions, prior Director approval for disciplinary actions, and statutory service rules, protecting fundamental constitutional administrative autonomy granted to minorities under Article 30(1).

questions.question_english:
With reference to the following, consider these statements regarding the School Management Committee (SMC) under the Right to Education (RTE) Act as applicable to Delhi government schools (harmonized with DSEA):
I. The SMC must comprise at least 75% parents or guardians of students.
II. 50% of the members of the SMC must be women.
III. The SMC is responsible for preparing the School Development Plan. Which of the above statements is/are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II, and III
questions.explanation_english: I, II, and III Under the Right to Education Act, 2009, harmonized with Delhi school governance, School Management Committees in government schools must comprise at least 75% parents or legal guardians, ensure 50% representation of women, and actively prepare the mandatory annual School Development Plan for structural and academic institutional improvements.
questions.explanation_hindi: तीनों कथन सही हैं। RTE अधिनियम और दिल्ली की विद्यालयी शासन-व्यवस्था के अनुरूप SMC में कम-से-कम तीन-चौथाई अभिभावक प्रतिनिधित्व और महिलाओं का 50 प्रतिशत प्रतिनिधित्व अपेक्षित है। समिति का एक महत्त्वपूर्ण कार्य विद्यालय विकास योजना तैयार करना भी है। इसलिए तीनों कथन SMC की संरचना और कार्यों से मेल खाते हैं।
questions.topic: Delhi Education Act, 1973 and Delhi School Education Rules, 1973
key_facts: Correct answer: D. I, II, and III

I, II, and III Under the Right to Education Act, 2009, harmonized with Delhi school governance, School Management Committees in government schools must comprise at least 75% parents or legal guardians, ensure 50% representation of women, and actively prepare the mandatory annual School Development Plan for structural and academic institutional improvements.

questions.question_english: Which of the following best describes the membership of the Parent-Teacher Association (PTA) under the DSER guidelines?
options_english: Only parents of students scoring above 80% are eligible.
Every parent of a student and every teacher of the school is a member.
Only the Head of School and nominated parents are members.
Membership is voluntary and requires an annual subscription fee of Rs. 1000.
questions.explanation_english: Every parent of a student and every teacher of the school is a member. Under guidelines framed pursuant to the Delhi School Education Rules, 1973, membership of the Parent-Teacher Association is universal within the institution. Every parent or legal guardian of a student enrolled in the school and every member of the teaching faculty automatically becomes a member of the Parent-Teacher Association upon enrollment or employment.
questions.explanation_hindi: PTA की सदस्यता में विद्यालय के प्रत्येक विद्यार्थी के अभिभावक और विद्यालय के शिक्षक शामिल होते हैं। इसे केवल उच्च अंक पाने वाले विद्यार्थियों के अभिभावकों या विद्यालय द्वारा नामित कुछ व्यक्तियों तक सीमित नहीं किया गया है। इसी व्यापक सदस्यता से घर और विद्यालय के बीच नियमित सहयोग तथा बच्चों के हित में संवाद संभव होता है।
